name: rapier
description: Rapier for Claude: a fast, offline Markdown editor for notes, diagrams, drawing and watercolor, with four skills and the MCP door.

plugins.name: rapier
plugins.description: Fast Markdown editor for notes, diagrams, drawing and watercolor painting, shared live with Claude. Claude works freely, beside you or while you are away. Rapier shows where it is and what it changed: tap a change to see what was there before, and undo anything. Pictures and editable drawings travel in one Markdown file; export Word, PDF or one offline HTML editor. No account. Shared documents stay in a private workspace that expires after 30 idle days.
